sections.section_title: Clinical Presentation and Complex Patient History
sections.description: This section introduces the patient's demographic profile, presenting symptoms, and the intricate medical history that sets the stage for a high-risk intervention. It details the progression from initial aortic stenosis through two prior TAVI procedures, the development of prosthetic valve endocarditis (PVE), and the eventual recurrence of severe valve dysfunction, establishing the clinical necessity for a third intervention.
subtopics: Demographics and Presenting Symptoms: Dyspnea, angina, and fatigue in a late-70s male
Comorbidity Burden: Hypertension, COPD, Diabetes, CAD with multiple PCIs, and GI bleeding history
Timeline of Structural Heart Disease: Initial 2014 Lotus valve implantation for severe stenosis
First Reintervention (2022): TAV-in-TAV with Evolut prosthesis and subsequent vascular complication
Infectious Complication: Diagnosis and treatment of Enterococcus faecalis PVE in 2022

sections.section_title: Diagnostic Reasoning and Multimodal Imaging Strategy
sections.description: Focusing on the transition from clinical suspicion to definitive procedural planning, this section explains how the team differentiated between active infection and structural failure. It emphasizes the critical role of advanced imaging (MSCT and TEE) in assessing 'triple-stented' anatomy, evaluating coronary obstruction risks, and determining the feasibility of a third transcatheter approach versus surgical explantation.
subtopics: Differentiating Active vs. Resolved Endocarditis: Role of blood cultures, TEE, and clinical markers
Hemodynamic Assessment: Echocardiographic findings of severe stenosis (Mean Gradient 49 mmHg) and regurgitation
Multislice CT (MSCT) Planning: Measuring lumen diameter (13.7 mm) in the Evolut frame
Coronary Obstruction Risk Analysis: Evaluating sinus dimensions, ostial height, and neo-skirt formation potential
Surgical Risk Stratification: EuroSCORE II calculation and contraindications for open-heart surgery

sections.description: This section provides a step-by-step breakdown of the third intervention. It details the strategic selection of the Acurate neo2 valve to optimize hemodynamics in a constrained space, describes the specific techniques used for high implantation to preserve coronary flow, and explains how commissural alignment was managed amidst multiple overlapping stent frames.
subtopics: Valve Selection Rationale: Advantages of Acurate neo2 (supra-annular design) in narrow anatomies
Access Strategy: Combined left radial and femoral approaches under local anesthesia
Implantation Depth Strategy: High placement relative to previous leaflets to prevent effective orifice area reduction
'Neo-Skirt' Management: Techniques to minimize obstruction of coronary ostia by overlapping frames
Optimization Maneuvers: Balloon pre-dilation/post-dilation under rapid pacing and final angiographic verification
